review_evidence: README identifies the project as a mechanization of Core Lilac probabilistic separation logic, including full soundness proofs and an embedding into iris-lean.
Ten of 13 Lean files contain 141 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.
The source formalizes probabilistic-program syntax, measurable-space infrastructure, separation assertions and soundness results, including measurability and splitting/footprint lemmas.
summary: Reviewed bppl-logic; retain the mechanization and soundness proofs for Lilac probabilistic separation logic.
